test_instructions: Launch <PowerToysCheckout>\x64\Debug\PowerToys.exe non-elevated on an English interactive desktop.
Run the non-signing Crop and Lock scenarios and verify Win32 thumbnail, reparent, cancellation, live pixels, input, and restoration behavior.
Prepare the documented trusted fixture and matching Runner/Settings signatures in an isolated VM, then run all 14 CropAndLock.UITests cases on Windows 10 and Windows 11 with zero skipped tests.
